name: Dandelion
pnw_notes: One of the earliest spring nectar sources for bees. Leaves are mildest before flowering. Flowers are safe for Jazzy. Blanch leaves briefly to reduce bitterness. Let a few go to seed to feed beneficial insects.

frost_hardiness.notes: Perennial — goes dormant in deep winter and re-emerges early spring. No protection needed.

planting_windows.notes: Surface sow, barely cover — needs light to germinate
Fall sowing also works well in mild zones
Harvest young leaves in spring before flowering; flowers available April–June for Jazzy and pollinators
